                                              💾 Backup & Restore

                                              Everything here lives only in this browser. Export a backup file regularly — compressed automatically for a smaller, faster file — clearing browser data or switching phones loses everything otherwise.

                                              ⚠️ Restoring will REPLACE everything on this phone with the backup file — bills, customers, catalog, loans, Udhaar, all of it. This can't be undone, so only restore onto a phone whose current data you don't need.

                                              ☁️ Cloud Auto-Backup

                                              Automatically saves a compressed copy to your connected Firebase project — no file to remember, works even if this phone is lost. Keeps the last 7 days, one tap away.

                                              Already paid some now? (optional)

                                              A web app can't open a direct Bluetooth/WiFi connection to a printer on its own — pair the printer once below, then Print always reaches it through your phone's own print system.

                                              1. Pair your HP printer in your phone's Bluetooth settings (or connect both to the same WiFi).
                                              2. Install the "HP Print Service Plugin" from Play Store — Android needs this to list HP printers in its print menu.
                                              3. Turn the plugin ON: Settings → Connected devices → Printing → HP Print Service.
                                              4. Tap "Print Now" below — pick your HP printer from the list that opens.
                                              1. Pair the thermal printer in your phone's Bluetooth settings first.
                                              2. Install a free print-bridge app like RawBT from Play Store — most 58mm/80mm printers use classic Bluetooth, which only a native app (not a webpage) can talk to directly.
                                              3. In RawBT, select your paired printer as the default.
                                              4. Tap "Print Now" below — choose RawBT from the print menu that opens.

                                              Only works if your printer supports Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) printing and you're on Android Chrome. Most budget thermal printers use classic Bluetooth instead and won't be found this way — use RawBT above if this doesn't work.
